title: Tempus AI Expands Collaboration with Merck and Moderna on Individualized Neoantigen Therapy
key_facts: Tempus AI announced an expanded collaboration with Moderna and Merck.
The collaboration supports the potential commercialization of intismeran autogene, described as a novel individualized neoantigen therapy.
Tempus will provide advanced next-generation sequencing (NGS) and sample collection workflows.
Tempus describes the aim as helping bring personalised cancer vaccines to patients at scale, combining its clinical infrastructure with mRNA innovation.
Founder and CEO Eric Lefkofsky said sequencing is becoming 'an integral part of the treatment itself' for individualised therapies.
quote_evidence: Today we announced an expanded collaboration with both Moderna and Merck to support the potential commercialization of intismeran autogene, a novel individualized neoantigen therapy.
Tempus will deliver advanced NGS sequencing and sample collection workflows.
Sequencing is no longer just about matching a patient to an existing treatment – with individualized therapies, it’s becoming an integral part of the treatment itself.
why_it_matters_hint: Genetic sequencing becomes part of making a personalised cancer vaccine.
notes: Source is Tempus AI's own announcement as shared on LinkedIn by its CEO and relayed by Oncodaily; no outside confirmation read. No financial terms or timeline stated.
